Fails identically at pristine base 1a89d258.

test-fs-rm.js.reason: Test runs real `git init` via child_process with cwd set to a directory that exists only in memfs (created by shim mkdirSync). The real child process cannot see memfs, so spawnSync fails ENOENT for /bin/sh. Unfixable in a memfs-backed browser shim. Fails identically at pristine base 1a89d258.

test-fs-utils-get-dirents.js.reason: Test requires internal/fs/utils (real Node binding, --expose-internals) to list a file created through the shim. The real binding operates on the real fs and cannot see memfs-only files. Unfixable in the shim; the harness syncs disk->memfs only. Fails identically at pristine base 1a89d258.
